units.source_text: 男人精疲力尽地靠在沙壁上。

en.t: The man leaned against the wall of sand, utterly exhausted.

units.source_text: 他把两臂和头嵌入沙中。

en.t: He buried both arms and his head in the sand.

units.source_text: 从领口流进去的沙子，在衬衫和长裤的分界线上鼓胀起来，成了个枕头的形状。

en.t: The sand that had slipped in through his collar swelled up at the line between his shirt and trousers, taking the shape of a pillow.

units.source_text: 突然，从胸口、头颈、额头，直到大腿内侧，咕咕地冒出了汗。

en.t: Suddenly sweat began bubbling out from his chest, neck, and forehead, all the way down to the insides of his thighs.

units.source_text: 刚才喝进去的水，又原封不动地冒了出来。

en.t: The water he had just drunk came pouring back out unchanged.

units.source_text: 汗水和沙子一化合，简直像贴了一张芥末膏药，

en.t: Once the sweat and sand combined, it was just like having a mustard plaster stuck to him,

units.source_text: 火辣辣地往皮肤里渗透。

en.t: burning and seeping into his skin.

units.source_text: 皮肤肿起来，成了橡胶的雨披。

en.t: His skin swelled up and became like a rubber rain cape.
